title: The Omnilex
description: Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine, the final machine.

puzzle.goal: To predict everything, add up every possible history. Slice the time from start to end into N steps of length ε; at each intermediate step the particle of mass m may be at any position x_k. Weight each zig-zag path by the phase e^{iS/ħ}, where S is the discretised action (kinetic minus potential energy V_k at each slice, times ε), integrate over all intermediate positions with the proper normalising factor per slice, and let the slicing become infinitely fine.
puzzle.name: Feynman path integral (time-sliced propagator)
puzzle.ask: For a free particle the sum over paths gives K = √(m/(2πiħT))·e^{imL²/(2ħT)}: only the classical path's phase survives. Find that phase mL²/(2ħT) in radians for an electron (m = 9.109e-31 kg) crossing L = @{L} m in T = @{T} s, with ħ = 1.055e-34 J s.

vars.x: positions x_k (integrated over every intermediate one)

puzzle.method: Split e^{−iHT/ħ} into N factors, insert a complete set of position states between each pair, and do the Gaussian momentum integral at each slice.
